map.广告直接或间接带来的收入: Revenue brought directly or indirectly by the ads
map.ROAS（Return on Ad Spend，广告支出回报率）是衡量广告投放效: ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is the core measure of advertising performance. It shows how many yuan of revenue each 1 yuan of ad spend brings and is the key metric for ad efficiency.
map.例如：花费5000元广告费，带来20000元收入，则 ROAS = 20000: For example spending 5000 CNY on ads to generate 20000 CNY of revenue gives ROAS = 20000 / 5000 = 4x (or 400%).
map.：广告效率很高，利润空间大: : very high ad efficiency with wide profit headroom
map.：勉强持平或微利，需要优化: : barely break-even or thin profit, needs optimization
map.：可能亏损，需大幅优化或停止投放: : possibly losing money, needs major optimization or stopping delivery
map.ROAS只考虑广告花费带来的收入，而ROI（投资回报率）考虑的是总成本（包括产品: ROAS only considers the revenue that ad spend generates, while ROI (return on investment) considers the profit against total cost, including product and operating cost. ROAS focuses on ad efficiency and ROI on overall profitability.

map.提高客单价和复购率，增加客户终身价值: Raise average order value and repurchase rate to grow lifetime value
map.A/B测试不同广告素材和投放策略: A/B test different creatives and delivery strategies
map.关注归因模型，合理评估各渠道贡献: Watch the attribution model and assess each channel's contribution fairly

ROAS ≥ 4 is excellent, 2.5-4 good, 1.5-2.5 average and below 1.5 poor; 2.0x sits at "average", so improve the creative for efficiency.
map.看毛利率。毛利率 50% 时平衡 ROAS=2，刚好打平；毛利率低则已亏，需结合: It depends on gross margin. At a 50% gross margin break-even ROAS = 2, exactly break-even; with a lower margin it is already a loss, so judge it together with profit.
map.ROAS=收入/花费，ROI=(收入−总成本)/总成本，ROI 扣了货与固定成本: ROAS = revenue / spend, while ROI = (revenue − total cost) / total cost; ROI deducts goods and fixed cost, so it reflects true profitability better.
